result.title: Interaction Retention and Output-Likelihood Training in Parallel Sampling
result.comment: 44 pages (35-page paper followed by a 9-page online appendix), 3 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
result.summary: Parallel samplers such as masked diffusion language models generate several coordinates per step from conditional marginals and randomize which coordinates are generated together, so even exact conditionals return a distorted distribution. We give an exact local account of this distortion. Around any full-support product law, the Gram operator of the sampler's response is diagonal in the interaction decomposition, and its eigenvalues are retention probabilities: the probability that an interaction has a unique latest-revealed coordinate. This retention spectrum determines the exact frontier between output accuracy and conditional calibration, its regularization path, and the population response of finite-mixture likelihood training. For pairwise interactions it yields a sharp dichotomy. Under homogeneous retention, output-likelihood training is equivalent to a single context gain; heterogeneous retention opens correction directions beyond any scalar, with an advantage bounded by an explicit heterogeneity gap. On binarized digits and MNIST, output-likelihood training within a heterogeneous schedule library lowers calibrated test negative log-likelihood in all twelve paired comparisons, and the gain survives pair-specific recalibration and a stronger path optimizer. For a frozen 169.6-million-parameter masked diffusion language model, serially normalized context gains are 1.070 and 1.056 at 8 and 16 rounds, against the predicted values 1.134 and 1.058.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从理论上刻画掩码扩散等并行采样器每步生成多个坐标时相对精确条件分布的局部失真：交互分解下响应 Gram 算子的特征值「retention 概率」决定输出准确性与条件校准的边界，并据此分析输出似然训练，在二值化数字、MNIST 与 1.696 亿参数掩码扩散语言模型上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 并行生成的分布失真及其经输出似然训练的校正，可供核查并行更新 latent 推理状态时的偏差与轨迹监督能否补偿；但原文不涉及视觉多模态推理，迁移仅为推测。
